I received this today as a promotional product.  I was amazed at the quality of the pitcher.  It comes with a HIGH polished stainless steel finish.  it is heavy duty and thick walled.  There is a Utopia kitchen stamp in the lower outside of the item that actually looks quite nice.  when I filled it and used it to pour with, I found that it poured very well without any dribbles or drips.  The handle is a nice size to fit into the hand comfortably and the opening at the top is sufficiently sized to be able to fit a sponge in it to give it a good wash.  What I really like is the fact it is seamless, so there are no places for bacteria to sit and cause problems.  The bottom is a nice wide bottom and sits flatly on the surface.  Over all I am very happy with this item and look forward to using it often in the future.

This coffee accessory is so attractive that I leave it in view. It is sleek and classically designed but completely functional at the same time. The rounded bottom makes for easy heat distribution. While the spout makes for a clean pour.

We needed a frothing pitcher for our espresso machine & we needed a small pitcher for our Mini Keurig. I am showing pictures of my red Keurig and this 12oz pitcher is used to catch the coffee. The mugs we use for coffee are typically too large to use with our Mini Keurig, except the small mugs that came with our set of dishes. My son has a 20oz travel mug & my other son and I like to use our 16oz reusable Starbucks mugs with lids. We had been using our 8oz Pyrex measuring cup to catch the coffee, but I hate the way it dribbles liquid when you pour. We tried a few other things but they didn't fit or didn't pour without dribbles.

I searched the reviews for all the 12oz frothing pitchers, and I want to say "Thank You" to everyone that reviews honestly, it really helps me to make an informed decision. This really sounded like the one I needed and was the only one that was mentioned for pouring without dribbling.

The frothing pitcher was delivered in a small Utopia box. When I opened the box it was in perfect condition, no rust or dings. I did notice the word Utopia was on the pitcher and a few people mentioned that in the reviews, but it is etched so lightly I can barely see it. I even took pictures of the side with

Revised review: product was defective when first received (the handle was detached). Customer service made aware and Dave responded promptly to offer refund or replacement free of charge. Product received today and looks perfect, steady. Therefore I revised my review to give compliment to the efforts made for better customer service.

Just as described, perfect for frothing milk, pours out without spilling. It is indeed stainless steel so I wouldn't put it through the dishwasher (dishwashers can create spots and discoloration on stainless steel due to the high temperature it washes at).
I'm also able to put the pitcher directly on the stove to heat the milk a little (I have a glass cooktop) and I just put it on the edge of the heating element so the handle is not directly over the heat and that way the handle doesn't even get hot and I can pick it up with bare hands.
